Native public FFmpeg filter graph includes packed/planar conversion, zscale widened triangle kernel with straight-alpha metadata and internal encoded-space premultiplication/unpremultiplication, final RGBA conversion and output pixel acquisition/release. Graph/source/frame wrappers and geometry contexts are reused; each call filters the full input. Native padded output rows exposed directly. Managed exact rational-reference pixels; native RGB maximum1/RMSE0.25 existing filtered comparison bound, RGBA8 alpha exact; approved RGBA16 native-only alpha maximum1/RMSE0.25; zero-alpha RGBzero; native CLI/deterministic output exact. No output cache or expression evaluator. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this downsample case is measured.

rejectedCandidateDecisions: Initial vector constructors caused repeated stack round trips; superseded by explicit register construction.

alphaConstructionDiagnostics.generatedCodeFinding: Vector64 widening and two-half Vector512 construction generated repeated stack stores/loads in the tap loop. Explicit scalar loads, register packing and Avx512F.InsertVector256 remove those round trips.

historicalFreshIdentityCorrection.reason: A timestamp-preserving source rollback left a stale compiled prototype. The original fresh-DLL QA assertion failed; it did not verify the accepted package. Original timed child/package identities remain valid.

rejectedProfileArchive.reason: Stale compiled four-tap prototype after timestamp-preserving source rollback; method identity differs from accepted package.
